cites.quote: A past appointment the patient did not attend, closed instead of staying Scheduled.
Given a patient with 1 Completed appointment, 1 Scheduled appointment and 1 Cancelled appointment, where the Cancelled one is the most recent

findings.text: No AC has a past appointment that is still Scheduled. A version that counts by date (past and not Cancelled = Completed or No-show) instead of by closed status passes every AC. The glossary says a No-show is closed rather than left Scheduled.

cites.quote: The Visit summary shows the number of the patient's `Completed` appointments.
Given a patient with 2 Completed appointments and 1 No-show appointment, when staff open the patient page

findings.text: Every AC sets up a single patient. A count missing the patient filter (all Completed/No-show appointments in the system) passes on a test database with one patient. REQ-2 and REQ-3 require only the patient's own appointments to be counted.

cites.quote: Given a patient with medical history recorded, when staff open the patient page, then the medical history shows the same fields and values as before the change.
The patient page's `medical history` is unchanged.

findings.text: REQ-8 (medical history unchanged) is tested only for a patient whose history is recorded. The partition with no medical history is missing, although the rubric asks for each partition of an unchanged requirement.
